3fccf913600c.name: Panke
3fccf913600c.text: Barclays ran the SpaceX x Tesla merger math. If SpaceX buys Tesla, Elon gets control of both. He'd own ~37% of the combined company but get ~56% of the votes. Why? His SpaceX shares get 10 votes each.
